up: Find all IC50 activity records for the target Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha isoform with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4005. For each record, return the following information: the molecule's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and standard InChI Key; the assay ID and assay description; and the literature reference, preferring the PubMed ID if available, otherwise the DOI.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cs.standard_inchi_key,
  a.assay_id,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4005'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
